title: Flex-RSI: Benchmarking Recursive Self-Improvement of Frontier Agents
first_seen_basis: GitHub issue created_at; earliest evidenced repository observation
hf_date_evidence: No HF recommendation date asserted by this watch evidence package.

object.quote: The improver I I operates on the harness: it analyses the executor’s trajectories and results, diagnoses failures, and revises the prompts, tools, and workflow of the executor as well as its own instructions and accumulated lessons.

feedback.quote: it analyses the executor’s trajectories and results, diagnoses failures, and revises the prompts, tools, and workflow of the executor

persistence.quote: a modification of I I changes how all subsequent modifications are made.

study.quote: and an improver then revises the harness, including the executor and itself.

verified_scope_policy: feed/taxonomy.yaml and feed/prompts/harness_gate.md: subsequent tasks OR improvement rounds, with actual external artifact modification
reason_zh: Harness 专项评测：明确区分 executor 修改任务产物与 improver 修改 executor / 自己的提示、工具和工作流；轨迹与评估结果驱动下一轮 Harness，并保持模型权重、评估器和划分固定。另有冻结 Harness 配对消融，因此不只是通用任务产物评测。
persistence_boundary: Harness changes affect subsequent improvement rounds. Cross-independent-task transfer is not established by the cited protocol; §5.4 transfers harnesses across models on the same task.
limitations: Each model/task result is one run; if repeated, the latest run is reported (§4.1).
Model coverage differs across tasks; do not describe the aggregate leaderboard as every model tested on every task.

Source ambiguity to report only: §4.1 and Table 1 identify RoboDojo/RoboCasa as 10/8 tasks, while §4.2 starter-zero sentence uses 4 of 8 RoboDojo and 7 of 10 RoboCasa; these suite denominators appear reversed. Do not silently correct original numbers.
The paired harness comparison covers seven pairs, with unequal realized stopping rounds; do not overstate generality.
This is source/scope/numeric-claim review, not experimental replication.
summary_zh: Flex-RSI 将任务解的改进与 Harness 改进分开：executor 修改解，improver 根据轨迹和结果改写 executor 及自身的提示、工具与工作流，后续轮次继续使用更新后的 Harness。模型权重、评估器和数据划分固定，最终解在隐藏测试集评分；论文另用冻结 Harness 配对运行检验 Harness 编辑的贡献。应归 Harness 专项评测，但各模型任务覆盖不齐、通常每格单次运行，不能据此夸大稳健性或跨任务迁移。
summary_en: Flex-RSI separates solution improvement from harness improvement: an executor edits the task solution, while an improver uses trajectories and results to revise the executor and its own prompts, tools, and workflow for later rounds. Model weights, evaluators, and data splits stay fixed, and the final solution is evaluated on hidden test data. Paired frozen-harness runs study the contribution of harness editing. Uneven task coverage and generally single runs limit claims of robustness or cross-task transfer.
